runs.rationale: Section 7 states employees can self-serve a password reset via the Northwire ID recovery page without IT involvement, so no ticket is needed — this is a simple forgotten-password case, not an MFA or lockout issue.
runs.final_response:
Good news — you can handle this yourself, no ticket needed. Just go to `id.northwire.internal/recover` and use the self-serve password reset flow: it'll send a reset link to your registered personal recovery email, or let you verify via the security question you set up at onboarding. IT involvement isn't required for a normal forgotten-password situation like this.

One note: this is just for your password. If you've also lost access to your MFA device/authenticator, that's a different process — it requires in-person or verified video identity check with Security and can't be done via ticket or chat.
